method: Raw Common Crawl cluster-index binary search plus byte-range retrieval and gzip decompression of both CDX blocks bracketing each ImageShack alias SURT prefix.
acceptanceRule: A CDX line is only a locator. Recovery requires range-fetching the referenced ARC/WARC record and independently validating HTTP status, binary signature, MIME, dimensions, and SHA-256.
scope: All 125 Common Crawl collections advertised by the frozen 2026-07-27 inventory; 20 historical ImageShack viewer, ID, CDN, and yfrog SURT aliases for object 79finalor9p/finalor9.png. A zero result is limited to those collections and aliases.
